name: Jetonomy

qa_actions.gate: ZERO FAIL lines. The total is a tripwire for accidentally-skipped phases, not the pass condition.
qa_actions.note: 286 is the total on a site where BuddyNext/WPMediaVerse is active. WPMediaVerse owns messaging site-wide, so Private_Messaging\Extension::is_dormant() is true, its REST routes are deliberately not registered, and Phase 3 skips the PM group by design (Basecamp 10150583760) - enabling the extension in jetonomy_pro_extensions does NOT change this and is not a fix. On a site WITHOUT WPMediaVerse the PM group runs and the total is HIGHER. Re-stamp this field, with verified_on_site, whenever a release adds or removes tests or the gate moves to a different site. 2026-09-03: 301 -> 309. Added DC1-DC3 (delete contract fires from the MODEL, and trashing does NOT fire it - a trashed post is restorable), XF1a/XF1b (the jetonomy_post_update_has_extension_data seam, asserted on the filter rather than on Pro's custom_fields so it holds with Pro inactive) and R1-R3 (Spam_Detector loadable, digest last-run is a timestamp not a truncated year, ai_cache index matches its schema). Every one was verified to FAIL with its fix reverted before being counted. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0): 348 -> 352 on a site with bbPress INACTIVE, which is the reference condition. Added IM1-IM4 (jt_import_map resolves a recorded source row, returns nothing for an unrecorded one, self-heals a mapping whose target was deleted, and scopes identity to source AND object type - the last one is what catches a regression to slug matching). The BB1-BB3 bbPress estimate block skips wholesale when bbPress has no content, so activating bbPress and seeding a forum raises the total to 362; that is the block reporting honestly, not a missing test. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, second pass): 352 -> 358. Added CV7-CV12, the ACCESS half of the category-visibility contract - CV1-CV6 only asserted LISTINGS, which is why a public space inside a hidden category kept serving its URL, its id, its topics and its JSON-LD to strangers after the listing fix shipped. CV7-CV10 were each verified to FAIL with the Permission_Engine and Space guards reverted; CV12 is the widen-check that stops the other five passing by denying everyone. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, third pass): 358 -> 361. Added CV13-CV15, the membership override - a hidden CATEGORY withholds its spaces from strangers, not from the members of a space inside it, matching what hidden has always meant on a space. CV14 (the read half) was verified to FAIL when the override is reverted; CV13 asserts the listing half, whose SQL cannot be reverted to the broken shape without also changing operator precedence back, so it is asserted but not revert-proven. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, settings round-trip): 361 -> 366. Added SV1-SV4 for the settings audit: an unrelated tab save no longer wipes the custom email templates (SV1, revert-proven) while the Email tab can still clear one (SV2), the empty post restriction unsets the key instead of storing 'members' (SV3, revert-proven), and container_width stores only its enum with the length in its own clamped key (SV4). SV4 asserts the stored contract, not the emitted CSS - that is built inside Template_Loader::render() and is verified in the browser (computed max-width 1200px, was none). 2026-09-22 (2.0.0 release blocker): 366 -> 367. IM1 used to SKIP when jt_import_map was absent, so the suite reported all-green on a site where the 2.0.0 migration had never run - the gate passed exactly when a release blocker was present. It is now IM0 and FAILS, with the consequence in the message. A skip is for a condition a site may legitimately not meet, never for a table this version was supposed to create.

_wp_path_note: Deliberately null. This field is machine-specific and fails SILENTLY when stale: it previously pointed at /Users/vapvarun/Local Sites/buddynext/app/public, which does not exist on other machines, while base_url pointed at buddynext.local - a site carrying its OWN jetonomy copy at 1.9.2 on main. A smoke run would have certified 1.9.2 and stamped the report with the release version. Derive the WP root three levels up from the plugin directory instead, per the wp-plugin-smoke skill.

model_env.why: Without this constant the Pro licence check fails, all 17 extensions never boot, zero jetonomy-pro/v1 REST routes register, and EVERY E and S check is reported as 'skipped' while the run still reads as a pass. The 2026-09-02 smoke skipped all 20 Pro checks for exactly this reason, in a release that shipped a Pro fix. Verify with: wp eval 'printf("%d\n", count(\Jetonomy_Pro::instance()->get_extensions()));' - expect 17, not 0.

coverage_gate.why: The build gate previously checked only that `failures` held no 'from' entries plus a version match, so a run that skipped 47 of 84 checks - including every Pro check - still satisfied it. Absence of failures is not coverage.
